hypothesis: If cells of similar size in complete surface contact under a uniform force (cortical tension) tend to form a pattern of hexagons, then in a living, expert-segmented and cell-tracked epithelium (Drosophila wing imaginal disc pouch, cultured ex vivo over hours) hexagons must be the clearly dominant polygon class (well above the ~0.29 six-sided fraction of a random Poisson-Voronoi partition and at least a majority), the hexagon fraction must not fall over time while the force keeps acting, and a cell's neighbour number should follow its relative size and local force rather than its division history.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered. For each of the five movies, use the TissueMiner database (tables cells, directed_bonds, vertices, cell_histories) to compute, per frame, the number of neighbours of every interior cell (cells sharing a bond with the margin/background cell are excluded), its area and whether it or its sister arose from a division within the preceding 60 min. Per movie report the time-averaged fraction of six-sided cells f6, mean and SD of neighbour number, the Spearman rho between f6 and frame time, and the coefficient of variation of cell area CV_A. The claim is supported if in at least four of the five movies f6 >= 0.60 (hexagons dominate as in the retinal pigment epithelium and the compound eye) and rho(f6, time) >= 0 (packing does not drift away from hexagons while tension acts), with mean neighbour number in [5.8, 6.2] and interior junctions predominantly three-way (>= 95%).
fail_criterion: Pre-registered. The claim is refuted if in at least four of the five movies f6 < 0.50 (hexagons are not even a majority in a tissue that satisfies Thompson's conditions of complete contact and uniform cortical tension) or rho(f6, time) < -0.3 with p < 0.05 (packing drifts away from hexagons). Results between the two thresholds (f6 in [0.50, 0.60), or movies split) are 'mixed'. As a pre-registered guard on Thompson's 'similar size' condition: if CV_A >= 0.6 (the level of a random partition) in the majority of movies the cells are not of similar size and the verdict is inconclusive with reason not-operationalizable. Diagnostic, not part of the verdict: the mean neighbour number of cells that divided within the preceding 60 min versus all other interior cells, and the Spearman rho between neighbour number and area relative to the frame median; a gap of >= 0.5 sides between recently divided and other cells, exceeding what area predicts, attributes departures from hexagons to division topology rather than to packing forces.

test_contract.expected_observation: In an epithelium of similar-sized cells in complete contact under cortical tension, six-sided cells are the clearly dominant class (fraction >= 0.60), the mean neighbour number is 6 with three-way junctions, and the hexagon fraction does not decline while the tissue is observed.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Six-sided cells are a minority (< 0.50) in such an epithelium, or the hexagon fraction declines over time while the cells remain in contact under tension, or the neighbour number is explained by division history rather than by cell size and forces.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: Public, licensed, expert-corrected cell-boundary segmentations of a living epithelium in which every cell is in full contact with its neighbours, with per-cell neighbour relations (or masks from which they follow), cell areas and, for the mechanism diagnostic, lineage over time; the tissue must not be one the claim's author used as his example (bee comb, coral, RPE) and the segmentation must not be produced by a method shown in this repo to round off junctions (Cellpose).
test_contract.inference_method: Per movie: time-averaged f6, mean and SD of neighbour number, Spearman rho of f6 against frame time, CV of cell area, fraction of three-way vertices; verdict by majority of movies against the fixed thresholds; a Poisson-Voronoi partition (f6 ~ 0.29, CV_A ~ 0.62) computed in the analysis script is the random baseline, and the published proliferating-epithelium polygon distribution (about 45% hexagons, Gibson et al. 2006) is the literature reference.

interpretation: Thompson's statement names epithelia in its scope and gives the sufficient conditions: similar size, complete surface contact, a uniform force. The Drosophila wing disc pouch is a columnar monolayer whose apical surfaces tile the plane without gaps under actomyosin cortical tension, so the conditions hold apart from the size uniformity that the pre-registered CV_A guard checks. 'A pattern of hexagons' is read as hexagons being the clearly dominant polygon class; the thresholds 0.60 and 0.50 are chosen so that the tissues Thompson cites as regular (RPE 0.67, compound eye 0.99 in claim-sources/cell-geometry) pass and a random partition (0.29) fails. The Lean proof of this claim (ThompsonLaws.Cells.hexagon_of_120) shows that 120 degree three-way junctions force six neighbours on average; this test asks whether living cells meeting Thompson's conditions actually are hexagons, and uses the lineage information to see whether departures come from cell division, a cause Thompson does not mention.
